claims.quote: Known only from Loreto region in northeastern (Amazonian) Peru.

regions.name: Itaya
regions.quote: Apistogramma eremnopyge (A218) is a dwarf cichlid known only from Loreto region in northeastern Peru, in the Itaya, Nanay and Tapiche drainages.

regions.name: Ucayali
